en: A sepia-tone vintage postcard showing a large, monumental building with classical architectural elements such as columns and a domed roof. The foreground includes a paved square and trees. The building is clearly labeled as a university library in both Croatian and French, indicating its educational purpose and international relevance. The text at the bottom identifies the city as Zagreb.
